goal: Add the domain function for correcting a book's title or author, so a later task can put an Edit button on the page. No page change in this task.
inputs: src/books.ts holds the pure domain functions; new logic goes there with unit tests in tests/books.test.ts.
Follow addBook's rule for a missing title or author: throw an Error.

acceptance_criteria.statement: renameBook(books, id, title, author) returns a new array in which the book with that id has the given title and author.
renameBook leaves every other book, and every other field of the renamed book, unchanged.
renameBook does not change the array it is given or any book in it.
renameBook throws an Error when the title is empty.
renameBook throws an Error when the author is empty.
renameBook throws an Error when no book has that id.
